question: ABCD is a parallelogram. P and Q are two points lying on the sides DC and AD respectively. The area of Delta APB ​​is equal to __________________.

options.text: half the area of ​​the quadrilateral ABPD
the area of Delta DQC के क्षेत्रफल
the area of (Delta BQC + Delta ABQ)

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

AB ∥ DC in parallelogram

P lies on DC ⇒ same height from AB

Triangles on same base AB and same height are equal

So ΔAPB = ΔADB = ΔBQC

**∴ Answer = ΔBQC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ABCD is a parallelogram

P lies on DC and Q lies on AD

**Formula used:**

Triangles on same base and between same parallels have equal area

 
 A B C D P Q 
• 

Q lies on AD (shown on line AD)

P lies on DC

AB ∥ DC

**Calculation:**

⇒ AB ∥ DC in parallelogram

⇒ P lies on DC ⇒ same perpendicular distance from AB

⇒ ΔAPB and ΔADB have same base AB and same height

⇒ area(ΔAPB) = area(ΔADB)

⇒ Also ΔADB = ΔBQC

**∴ The correct answer is ΔBQC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Same Base Theorem

Triangles on same base and between same parallels are equal

Parallelogram Property

Opposite sides are parallel

Height Concept

Points on parallel lines have equal perpendicular distance

4b:T
